summary.conclusion: Removing marker genes from prompts changes the CLOP conditioning vectors (mean cosine: 0.9728) and DiT latent embeddings (mean cosine: 0.9465). However, the scGPT decoder collapses these differences (expression cosine: 1.000000). This indicates that marker genes in prompts DO affect the latent representation but the frozen scGPT decoder cannot translate these differences to expression.
